title: [Shortcut Guide] Tab order enters unnamed panes and cannot reach shortcut rows
summary: The report provides a precise keyboard-only reproduction, expected focus behavior, the observed focus sequence, and a clear accessibility impact. The behavior is sufficiently scoped for a design investigation without needing to infer a root cause.

status.label: actionable design
status.detail: Start an accessibility-focused design investigation covering Tab-stop ownership, accessible names, realized shortcut-row focusability, and keyboard access to Pin/Unpin actions.

judgment.rationale: The report provides a precise keyboard-only reproduction, expected focus behavior, the observed focus sequence, and a clear accessibility impact. The behavior is sufficiently scoped for a design investigation without needing to infer a root cause.
evidence: The issue specifies PowerToys 0.101.2312.0 and the Shortcut Guide accessibility surface.
The reporter documents the exact Tab sequence, including two unnamed Pane stops.
Shortcut rows are present in the UI Automation tree but are not reachable through keyboard focus.
The report separately confirms that application-rail Up/Down navigation works, narrowing the affected behavior to focus order and row reachability.
The issue has Area-Accessibility and Product-Shortcut Guide labels and no visible assignee or linked work.
judgment.recommended_action: Start an accessibility-focused design investigation covering Tab-stop ownership, accessible names, realized shortcut-row focusability, and keyboard access to Pin/Unpin actions.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Approve a focused design investigation for this recent issue.
